package rulefixtures

import (
	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
)

// scenario for gin_engine_as_global_singleton: Package-level `*gin.Engine` singletons reused across unrelated startup paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.

var engine = gin.Default()

func init() {
	engine.GET("/health", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(200, gin.H{"status": "ok"})
	})
}

func StartServer() {
	engine.GET("/users", func(c *gin.Context) {
		c.JSON(200, gin.H{"users": []string{}})
	})
	engine.Run(":8080")
}
